Harbor Lights opens its Denver roastery

By Rosa Alvarez · November 25, 2026

Harbor Lights Coffee opened its third roastery in Denver on Tuesday, a 9,000-square-foot space in the River North Art District that will supply the Mountain region's twelve cafés. The opening brings the company to 71 employees across Portland, Austin and Denver.

Daniel Okafor, who runs the Mountain region, said the roastery would cut delivery times to Colorado and Utah cafés from four days to one. The company expects the site to roast 400,000 pounds of coffee in its first year.

The Denver opening follows the 2017 move of the company's headquarters to Austin and the 2019 launch of the subscription service, which now accounts for a quarter of revenue.
